contract.alarm: unchanged global Euclidean kNN-20; first q>=7 with distance > frozen threshold
contract.causal_timing: q+1, after executing the native alarm query
contract.diagnostic_timing: max(0,q-5); retrospectively placed, never a deployable trigger
contract.candidate_pool: four iid N(0,1) [10,24] arrays, batch=1, all full forwards counted
contract.ranking: same-observation candidates only; no suffix, outcome, task identity or simulator progress
contract.knn: minimum frozen 10D successful-reference distance; relative ranking after shortened chunks is not calibrated failure probability
contract.guard: candidate 0 is always eligible; same first gripper sign and live-action RMS <= pool median relative to candidate 0
contract.center_edge: mean pairwise Hellinger on HB back four layers, first three flow steps, action tokens
contract.recovery: fixed finite query burst, then native chunk=10 and one random candidate
contract.random_stream: policy paired by branch-relative query across times/arms; environment paired by absolute action step
contract.restore: complete exact C0 before any branch; main committed before replay
contract.labels: all four first candidates receive complete suffix labels; oracle is diagnostic only

selection: fixed hash within benchmark/category; development conditions on an eligible alarm, never on outcome; validation includes unalarmed parents
